authority.alpha_prerequisite: C-06i must convert the retained persisted-filter candidate into one authenticated rrflowKV physical-format behavior before C-06 can close. Normal reopen must obtain the filter from authenticated metadata and prune in-range point misses before semantic Arrow-page I/O while exact MVCC, recovery, snapshots, compaction, garbage collection, and projected reads remain unchanged.

current_behavior: The clean C-06i candidate screen measured segment-v4 normal reopen and found 16,234 filter checks, zero negatives, and 426 semantic page loads because Database::open installs allow-all filters. Its deterministic ten-bit-per-unique-key, seven-hash serialized Bloom candidate used 13,304 bytes, produced zero member false negatives and a 0.634 percent absent-key false-positive rate, and was the only candidate retained for immediate integration. Segment v4 has no persisted filter framing. Segment::open reconstructs a private filter only after loading all key pages; Database::open authenticates metadata but cannot prune misses without those reads. The laboratory duplicates the candidate filter instead of consuming a canonical format implementation.
target_behavior: Replace the pre-release segment format directly with v5. Every authenticated row-group index entry records its unique-key count and embeds one bounded RRFlow Bloom filter using the retained ten-bit-per-unique-key, minimum-64-bit, seven-double-hash policy. Parsing derives the exact permitted word count from authenticated metadata and rejects unknown algorithms, noncanonical lengths, nonzero reserved bytes, truncation, and malformed parameters. Full validation reconstructs the filter from decoded unique keys and requires byte-exact equality before writer publication, snapshot acceptance, or standalone open. Normal Database reopen uses persisted filters without loading semantic pages; definite in-range point misses must record negatives and skip page loads. V4 is an unsupported negative input with no reader, migration, fallback, or parallel authority. The laboratory reuses the canonical implementation. Open evidence and rrflowKV traces report persisted filter count and bytes. Frozen segment, manifest, snapshot, fuzz, malformed-byte, MVCC, compaction, projected-read, recovery, and store-boundary proofs move to the sole v5 format.
unchanged_behavior: RrdEngine remains the sole semantic transaction, authorization, reasoning, recall, installation, attunement, and lifecycle authority; rrflowKV owns physical persistence and read evidence only.

Product version 1.0.0, WAL v1, batch v2, manifest v3, CURRENT publication, application key format RRKV0001, key ordering, MVCC visibility, writer exclusion, durability boundaries, snapshot ownership, compaction publication, garbage collection, and projected-read semantics remain unchanged.
This is direct pre-release convergence: only v5 is readable and writable after the package. No v4 reader, converter, feature flag, fallback, deprecation path, or alternate backend is added.
The filter accelerates point reads only. It cannot establish semantic presence, positive results still perform exact key/version lookup, and range/projected scans never use it for exclusion.

Compression remains none, values remain inline, and the exact-byte LRU is unchanged. LZ4, Zstandard, cache admission, Moka, value separation, and family placement require later separately planned evidence.
DataFusion is not added to rrd-lsm. F-01 owns the stamped asynchronous rrflowQL TableProvider, pushdown, RecordBatch streaming, cancellation, spill, and shared resource ledger over this source.

Graph, scalar, BM25, vector, ANN/TurboQuant, RRF, reasoning/context, triggers/routines/skills, installed binaries, SDK/API conformance, Connectome, and deployment are not implemented or qualified here.
No competitor, latency, scale, zero-copy, or alpha-readiness claim is made from this filter slice; C-06 remains open for remaining physical-policy and gate evidence.

first_failure_oracle: The baseline normal-reopen characterization must reproduce nonzero checks, zero negatives, and nonzero page loads for deterministic in-range absent keys.
V5 Database::open must authenticate nonzero persisted filter count/bytes with zero semantic page requests and loads during open.
Every inserted unique key must be a member and full validation must reconstruct byte-identical filter words; any false negative or mismatch is corruption.
Deterministic absent probes must produce negatives and fewer page loads than the frozen v4 observation while present and tombstone/MVCC reads remain exact.
Filter-byte mutations with the outer checksum recomputed must still be rejected by framing or canonical reconstruction.
Versions 1 through 4 and unknown version 6 must fail before alternate decoding; no v4 positive fixture, target, or compatibility branch remains.
Complete rrd-lsm and rrd-store regression suites must pass before the filter is called integrated.
